acceptanceCriteria.text: Confirmed claimed reports compact into daily counts by type and known battle results with replay-safe minimal dedup markers; canonical/raw Mail caches drop claimed details.
Daily observed claim rewards count once from confirmed responses, account/expiry/older-snapshot guards hold and native report actions still reach combat controllers.
Mail groups pending reports and displays concise daily summaries without per-report claimed rows; claim actions and unknown rewards remain accurate.
Migration, replay, pagination, claim/native order, account and UI regressions plus full checks/build and docs validation pass.

checkpointPayload.description: Replace duplicate claimed battle-report storage/display in Mail with account-scoped daily aggregates, retaining pending claims and operational battle-result reducers. Use30 UTC days of observed statistics and minimal dedup keys; no invented rewards or optimistic claim completion.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Inspect report extraction, claim receipts and Mail cache ownership. 2. Add bounded account-scoped daily compaction and minimal dedup metadata, invoked by canonical prune after combat actions. 3. Group pending reports and render daily summary with explicit UTC/observed scope. 4. Verify migration, duplicates, stale/new responses, claim/account/resource precedence and real Chrome UI; document and build.
checkpointPayload.title: Compact claimed battle reports into daily mail statistics

taskChanges.newValue: Implemented account-scoped battleReportSummary with30 UTC days of observed claimed counts/types/results, normalized confirmed claim rewards by claim date, minimal ID/day/outcome and token/day replay guards. Compaction removes claimed canonical/raw Mail reports and full report-claim payloads after operational reducers run; preserves pending claims, pagination, native single/bulk confirmation, fresh snapshots and old-account guards. Legacy receipts migrate without changing balances; later pages enrich unknown outcomes once. Mail groups pending reports and shows collapsed daily totals with explicit observed/UTC/date scope. Review checked migration, immutability, replay, same-batch balances, rejected/native claims, retention/account changes and receipt compaction; no outstanding findings. Verification:870 tests,858 pass,12 optional skips; typecheck/build0.10.97 pass; runtime hashes match dist. Actual Chrome Direct/Piggyback fixture passed, evidence docs/acceptance/mail-summary-2026-11-15.json. Spec Decision Compliance: N/A (standalone Mail task); existing combat/claim confirmation preserved. System Decision Impact: candidate @decision/20261115-1550-archive-claimed-mail-battle-reports-as-daily-aggregates (changed) — claimed report retention becomes daily observed aggregates.
